hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring revenue (ARR) is the main driver of Adobe's growth, supported by massive adoption of its cloud solutions and strategic integration of AI in Creative Cloud and Digital Experience.

kpis.signal: Solid growth of the recurring model, valuation driver
Double-digit growth supported by cloud subscriptions
High margin typical of cloud software
Sustained investment in software innovation and AI
Slight workforce reduction to improve operating efficiency

ai_positioning.summary: Adobe strategically integrates generative AI into its product portfolio, positioning AI as a central element of its value proposition.
